verdict.rationale: Elastic APM documents grouping errors primarily by stack trace, spotting new errors as they appear, and tracking how often specific errors occur. That covers the grouping and stack-trace core of the story. Nothing in the pack documents tying errors to releases or detecting when a resolved error returns; 'identify new errors' is not the same as regression detection. Missing for 10: release/version tracking for errors, regression detection for resolved issues, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see application errors grouped into issues with stack traces, release tracking, and regression detection

citations.quote: Errors are grouped based primarily on the stack trace, so you can identify new errors as they appear and keep an eye on how many times specific errors happen.
